signal: Bulbshare, the AI-powered customer insight community platform, was acquired by Service Management Group and now powers always-on insight communities for brands like Nestle and Premier Foods

email.body1:
Doug, saw Bulbshare join Service Management Group and keep scaling AI-powered insight communities for brands like Nestle.

Becoming part of a larger group usually opens more enterprise brand accounts than a sales team can personally cover, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Bulbshare off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for Bulbshare.

Inside SMG, the addressable list of brands worth a conversation grows faster than a sales team can call them. Most enterprise sellers can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bulbshare needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for Bulbshare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bulbshare's reply rate likely compares to similar SaaS and insights companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating into a larger group is its own kind of busy, and timing matters here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Bulbshare either way.
